caption:
Costa Rica’s mountain ridges are natural boundaries for weather. When you are mountain biking in Costa Rica, a single climb can take you from humid valley air to a cool, mist-swept ridge where the wind smells of wet earth and moss. The roads here do not curve gently around the topography; they follow the spine of the hills, offering steep gradients that demand everything from your legs and absolute silence from your mind. Up here, there are no engines, no schedules, and no easy kilometres. Just the quiet click of a freehub and the space to breathe it all in.
